title: Missing Zscaler Client Connector GNOME Tray icon for Linux

blocks.text: Using the Zscaler Client Connector GNOME tray icon in Linux distributions requires enabling the third-party GNOME extension, AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support.
When enabling this extension with openSUSE 15.3 and 15.4 Leap with GNOME Desktop, there is a known issue where the tray icon does not display on the screen.
